segments.name: Laser Products
segments.description: Designs, manufactures and sells high-power semiconductor and fiber lasers, fiber amplifiers and beam combination systems for defense, industrial and microfabrication customers.
segments.evidence: This segment includes high-power semiconductor lasers and fiber lasers that are typically integrated into laser systems or manufacturing tools built by our customers.

segments.name: Advanced Development
segments.description: Runs research, design and prototyping programs that give governmental agencies next-generation directed energy and laser sensing technologies.
segments.evidence: Centered around providing governmental agencies with next-generation laser technologies and solutions, our capabilities include the development of custom high-power fiber lasers and advanced beam combining technologies.

revenueModel.text: Original equipment manufacturers and other customers buy lasers, amplifiers and beam control systems for their own systems and tools, and governmental agencies fund development programs.
revenueModel.evidence: We design, manufacture, and sell a range of high-power semiconductor lasers and fiber lasers that are typically integrated into laser systems or manufacturing tools built by our customers.
